svg.title: RFID / NFC: reader, writer or emulator?
svg.desc: Capability planning for documented NFC parts. Reading, writing and card emulation are separate operations; chip features do not guarantee module firmware support.

g.text: MCU-to-module wiring and module-to-tag radio protocol must both match.
Capability planning for documented NFC parts. Reading, writing and card emulation are separate
operations; chip features do not guarantee module firmware support.
Original Black Wire connection diagram. Documentation reviewed; not independently bench-tested.
